## Bio

Hi! I am Kashish Patel, an MPH candidate at Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, concentrating in Epidemiology and Biostatistics. I am a recent medical graduate from India with an aim to pursue a general surgery residency in the USA. As a participant in JSCOR's program (Johns Hopkins Surgical Center for Outcomes Research), I am learning to design, conduct and analyze health-services research using surgical databases under the guidance of a surgeon-mentor.
